preconditions.description: The number of elements in permutation p must be between 1 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in p) and len(set(p)) == n
preconditions.description: The permutation p must contain exactly n distinct integers, each between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(q) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in q) and len(set(q)) == n)
postconditions.description: If no valid permutation q exists, output '-1'. Otherwise, output a permutation q of length n with distinct integers between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(q[q[i] - 1] == p[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The permutation q must satisfy the condition that q^2 = p, meaning q[q[i] - 1] must equal p[i] for all i from 0 to n-1.
